title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Our favourite part of Malaysia was the food! Delicious and decadent, it’s no wonder Malaysia has the third-highest incidence of diabetes per capita.

Jalan Alor food street in Kuala Lumpur is accused of being a tourist trap, but we were drawn to it like moths to a flame. In a single night, we gorged on mee goreng, cockles, oysters, frogs, beef satays, mango sticky rice, and matcha ice cream.
Nasi lemak, the national dish, is a divine experience.
Good Timing Food Village in Jalan Alor was a spot we hit multiple times. In Langkawi, Yasmin serves phenomenal Syrian food. The lamb mandi was to die for!
